config.headline: Tired of Reading Chemical Labels You Can't Pronounce?
config.content: Most commercial soaps are packed with synthetic detergents, artificial fragrances, and harsh preservatives that strip your skin's natural moisture barrier. You deserve better than ingredients you can't understand.

items.title: Suitable for Sensitive Skin

items.title: Proudly Kenyan

config.headline: Our Story: From Kitchen to Craft
config.content:
NALA began in a small kitchen with a simple mission - to create soap we'd feel good about using on our own families.

Frustrated by commercial products full of chemicals we couldn't pronounce, we started experimenting with organic oils and botanicals from our garden.

What started as a personal passion quickly grew into Nature's Lather (NALA) - a commitment to transparency, quality, and skin health.

Every bar is still made by hand, in small batches, with ingredients we'd proudly display on our own bathroom shelves.

items.question: How long does a bar last?
items.answer: With proper care (keeping it dry between uses), each bar lasts 4-6 weeks with daily use. Using a soap dish with drainage helps extend the life of your soap.

items.question: Are your soaps suitable for sensitive skin?
items.answer: Absolutely! Our soaps are pH-balanced with natural glycerin retained. We use no synthetic fragrances or harsh chemicals. The Exfoliant soap with oatmeal is particularly gentle.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept M-Pesa (our primary payment method), bank transfers (KCB, Equity, Cooperative), and Cash on Delivery for Nairobi area only.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Nairobi: Same-day or next-day. Major towns (Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru): 2-3 days. Other locations: 3-5 days via courier.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Yes! We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied, contact us for a full refund.

items.question: Are your soaps vegan?
items.answer: Most of our soaps are vegan. The Turmeric soap contains goat milk, so it's vegetarian but not vegan. All soaps are cruelty-free.
